To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a multi-stage hierarchical process that represents context at different levels and uses bi directional flow of attention mechanism to obtain query aware context representation is a better model, (2) a model with bi-directional attention flow mechanism that is trained to maximize the probability of the answer span given the question and context outperforms the state of the arts, and (3) our model is robust to the size of the training data.
1) the proposed model outperforms the previous state of the art models by 3.5% in F1 score and 2.6% in EM score, 2) the model can be easily trained on a single GPU in less than an hour.

(1) Bi directional attention flow is a useful mechanism for modeling complex interactions between context and queries in MC; and (2) BIDAF achieves state of the art MC results on SQuAD and CNN/Daily Mail cloze test.
